title: A FILE HAS EDGES

V01 self-review crop retained lower face despite a face-exclusion statement; V02 uses corrected crop(64,128,256,240), before independent first review. Physical film gauge remains unknown. Search results alone are not claimed watched or licensed.

sound: Own source intervals only where declared; new compositions/synthesis explicitly identified. Original source scoring/dubbing not certified synchronous. No actual audio audition or native-speed audiovisual review. Digital-silence claims apply to authored PCM intervals before AAC, not codec-edge leakage.
rights: Underlying cache permission/participant consent not independently audited. NASA and PAO provenance recorded, not a general rights guarantee. Private study exports only; no public publication or external messaging.
